issues.title: Ingest Craighead County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $59,784,096 across 49 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($28,810,744), County Road Department Fund ($11,476,649), American Rescue Plan Fund ($3,998,766). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
